content:
The image shows a mango leaf with distinct dark brown/black irregular lesions scattered across the leaf surface. The lesions are sunken, necrotic spots with defined margins, some appearing to have concentric rings or irregular shapes — classic symptoms of fungal infection.

Key observations:
- Dark brown/black discrete spots on an otherwise green leaf
- Lesions appear slightly sunken/necrotic
- No white powdery coating (rules out Powdery_Mildew)
- No black sooty surface coating covering large areas (rules out Sooty_Mould)
- No tip/branch dieback pattern (rules out Die_Back)
- Discrete, irregular dark lesions consistent with Anthracnose (*Colletotrichum gloeosporioides*), which is a hallmark of mango anthracnose
